source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The 1214 loader establishes its database connection on the main thread, asserts that InternalLoadFolders runs off that thread, and dispatches promise resolution back to the main thread. A main-thread pointer holder carries the promise between tasks, and Folder refcounting changes to the thread-safe declaration. This is the historical handoff contract, not proof that all Folder operations were thread safe or that on-disk reconciliation moved in the same patch. The accepted implementation has replaced this API; no thread-safety or profiler run was performed. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Historical background folder loading returns promise settlement to the main thread
